annotations.text:
HERO — DESKTOP 1440x900

The one compositional move: the headline overlaps the portrait, and the portrait sits behind it. Line 4 runs 44px under the portrait's left edge; a gradient on the portrait keeps the type readable.

Amber appears in exactly five places: the full stop, three proof ticks, the scroll line, the duotone, the glow.

VARIANT B — NO PORTRAIT

Insurance. If the photography isn't strong enough, this is the fallback: headline steps up to 132px, proof strip rotates onto the right margin, scroll cue goes horizontal.

Worth comparing honestly — this one may be the stronger design.

HERO — MOBILE 390x844

DEVIATION FROM SPEC: five lines, not four. At 390px the four-line break forces 42px type, which undersells the hero. Splitting USEFUL / THINGS. buys 56px.

Headline leads; the portrait never appears above it.

FOUNDATIONS

Tokens as an editorial spread rather than a swatch dump.

Body face is Instrument Sans, not Inter as originally specced — Inter is the single most overused UI face and would have undercut the 'made by an engineer with taste' read. Same metrics class, so nothing else moves.

The Accent tweak above each artboard recolours the whole system live.
